item.title: Re: Clowns (seeking greenlights)
item.content:encoded: Everyone but the owner of the doll believes that it is creepy, almost horrifyingly so and prefer not to be around it or they will try to get rid of it. The owner on the other hand would believe it gives them some type of protection(I haven't decided if it does or not — maybe it makes them have pleasant dreams and when removed causes nightmares of the doll's "true"/frightening appearance. I thought this might clutter so it might just not do that.) and will become violent or angry if the doll is removed or even insulted, which would be boosted by the doll's effects on strength. Testing would be done to see the range of the dolls effects, if they could be used for benefit, how the effects change over distance/if the doll was separated from the owner for a period of time (the discovery on the separation would be that if separated long enough the owner will begin to feel antsy—similar to a withdrawal situation) and also on what exactly the doll/the force behind the doll considers "ownership" (does a previous owner have to die, or is giving the doll up enough?).

item.title: Re: Clowns (seeking greenlights)
item.content:encoded: You really haven’t written enough for a proposal. You have 400 words, you’ve written about 100. I’m left confused about many parts of this. Does everyone not see the doll as creepy or just the owner? If it’s everyone than what’s the difference between that and just not being creepy? What kinds of tests are done on the doll? But I think the most important question is what is your focus in this article? I could see an obviously creepy doll that isn’t seen as creepy being played for fear or laughs, and I have no idea which you’re planning on doing. So my apologies if it’s a little harsh but I suggest you fully plan out this SCP. It’s not a fundamentally bad idea but it feels like even you don’t know what you’re doing.

item.title: Clowns (seeking greenlights)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: Inheritable clown doll that makes people think that it's not creepy when it is. Owner of doll gets attached to it and will defend it, gaining strength if necessary.

Central Narrative: Will detail the known history of the doll's owners and research and tests done on it as well as focus on the effects of the doll.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The doll doesn't appear to be sapient, but some other force may be at work when it comes to selecting the doll's "owners" as it is able to recognize being passed down.

Additional Notes: I'm worried the "creepy doll/creepy clown" thing is a bit overplayed or cliche, but I think it adds to this particular idea.
